commits.author: Yurii D.
commits.message:
Add new rule AvoidMixingJunit4AndJunit5 (#147) (#198)

Introduce an XPath-based PMD rule that flags a test class mixing JUnit 4
(org.junit.*) and JUnit 5 (org.junit.jupiter.*) annotations or imports in
the same class, which silently causes some tests/lifecycle callbacks to be
ignored by the configured engine.

The rule lives in a new testing ruleset
io/github/dgroup/arch4u/pmd/testing/junit.xml and is wired into the
aggregate arch4u-ruleset.xml. Detection covers imported and fully-qualified
annotations as well as static imports. Adds 10 test cases and a readme entry.

Closes #147

https://claude.ai/code/session_012p4bAJd2Ck8Zic6jUuch1y

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
